content:
Count lamps toggled an odd number of times by switches 2, 3, and 5, then subtract from 1000.

- Divisible by all three: \(\left\lfloor \frac{1000}{30} \right\rfloor = 33\)
- Divisible by exactly one:
  - only 2: \(500 - 166 - 100 + 33 = 267\)
  - only 3: \(333 - 166 - 66 + 33 = 134\)
  - only 5: \(200 - 100 - 66 + 33 = 67\)

So odd toggles: \(33 + 267 + 134 + 67 = 501\).

Thus lamps remaining on: \(1000 - 501 = 499\).

\boxed{499}
